author: Marlon Chaviano
name: saas-tanstack-start
title: SaaS with TanStack Start
description: TanStack Start with the official add-ons: Better Auth, Drizzle, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query and TanStack Form, with typed routes and server functions.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Routes are files in `src/routes/`. Anything that touches the database or secrets goes in `createServerFn` and checks the Better Auth session on the server.
- Server data with TanStack Query and forms with TanStack Form; components from `src/components/ui/` (shadcn/ui).
- Before finishing: `npm run build`.
